//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Respawning Shulkers -> Config

Enable Respawning Shulkers.//: Whether Respawning Shulkers is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

timeInTicksToRespawn.//: The amount of time in ticks it takes for a shulker to respawn after it died. 20 ticks = 1 second. By default 60 seconds. min: 1, max: 72,000

shulkersFromSpawnersDoNotRespawn.//: If enabled, shulkers which spawn from (modded) spawners will not be respawned after a death.
